{{Infobox 
| bodyclass   = vcard
| child       = {{{child|}}}
| aboveclass  = n
| abovestyle  = font-size:125%;background-color:gold; color:inherit;
| above       = {{br separated entries
 | 1 = {{#if:{{{honorific prefix|}}}{{{honorific_prefix|}}}{{{honorific-prefix|}}}|<div class="honorific-prefix" style="display:inline;font-size: 77%; font-weight: normal;">{{if empty|{{{honorific prefix|}}}|{{{honorific_prefix|}}}|{{{honorific-prefix}}}}}</div>}}
 | 2 = <includeonly><div style="display:inline;" class="fn">{{if empty|{{{name|}}}|{{PAGENAMEBASE}}}}</div></includeonly>
 | 3 = {{#if:{{{honorific suffix|}}}{{{honorific_suffix|}}}{{{honorific-suffix|}}}|<div class="honorific-prefix" style="display:inline;font-size: 77%; font-weight: normal;">{{if empty|{{{honorific suffix|}}}|{{{honorific_suffix|}}}|{{{honorific-suffix}}}}}</div>}}
 }}

| image       = {{#invoke:InfoboxImage|InfoboxImage |image={{{image|}}} |size={{if empty|{{{image_size|}}}|{{{imagesize|}}}}} |sizedefault=frameless |upright=1 |alt={{{alt|}}} |suppressplaceholder=yes}}
| caption     = {{{caption|}}}

| headerstyle = background-color:gold; color:inherit;

| header1     = {{{titles|}}}

| label2      = Born
| data2       = {{br separated entries|{{{birth_name|}}} |{{{birth_date|}}} |{{{birth_place|}}} }}

| label3      = Hometown
| data3       = {{{home_town|}}}

| label4      = Residence
| data4       = {{{residence|}}}

| label5      = Died
| data5       = {{br separated entries |{{{death_date|}}} |{{{death_place|}}} }}

| label6      = Cause&nbsp;of death
| data6       = {{{death_cause|}}}

| label7      = Resting place
| data7       = {{br separated entries |{{if empty|{{{resting_place|}}}|{{{resting place|}}}}} |{{if empty|{{{resting_place_coordinates|}}}|{{{resting place coordinates|}}}}} }}

| label8      = {{#if:{{{honoured_in|}}}|Honoured|{{#if:{{{honored_in|}}}|Honored|Venerated}}}}&nbsp;in
| data8       = {{if empty|{{{honoured_in|}}}|{{{honored_in|}}}|{{{venerated_in|}}}}}

| label9      = [[Beatification|Beatified]]
| data9       = {{#if:{{{beatified_date|}}}|{{{beatified_date}}}{{#if:{{{beatified_place|}}}|, {{{beatified_place}}}}} {{#if:{{{beatified_by|}}}| by {{{beatified_by}}}}}}}

| label10      = [[Canonization|Canonized]]
| data10       = {{#if:{{{canonized_date|}}}|{{{canonized_date}}}{{#if:{{{canonized_place|}}}|, {{{canonized_place}}}}} {{#if:{{{canonized_by|}}}| by {{{canonized_by}}}}}}}

| label11     = {{nowrap|Major [[shrine]]}}
| data11      = {{{major_shrine|}}}

| label12     = [[Calendar of saints|Feast]]
| data12      = {{{feast_day|}}}

| label13     = [[Saint symbolism|Attributes]]
| data13      = {{{attributes|}}}

| label14     = [[Patron saint|Patronage]]
| data14      = {{{patronage|}}}

| label15     = Controversy
| data15      = {{{issues|}}}

| label16     = {{longitem|[[Cult (religious practice)#In Christianity|Catholic cult]] suppressed}}
| data16      = {{{suppressed_date|}}}{{#if:{{{suppressed_by|}}}|&nbsp;by {{{suppressed_by}}}}}

| label17     = Influences
| data17      = {{{influences|}}}

| label18     = Influenced
| data18      = {{{influenced|}}}

| label19     = {{longitem|Tradition or genre}}
| data19      = {{{tradition|}}}

| label20     = {{nowrap|Major works}}
| data20      = {{{major_works|}}}

| data21      = {{if empty|{{{misc|}}}|{{{module|}}}}}
| data22      = {{if empty|{{{misc2|}}}|{{{module2|}}}}}
| data23      = {{if empty|{{{misc3|}}}|{{{module3|}}}}}
| data24      = {{if empty|{{{misc4|}}}|{{{module4|}}}}}
| data25      = {{if empty|{{{misc5|}}}|{{{module5|}}}}}
| data26      = {{if empty|{{{misc6|}}}|{{{module6|}}}}}
}}{{#invoke:Check for unknown parameters|check|unknown={{main other|}}|preview=Page using [[Template:Infobox saint]] with unknown parameter "_VALUE_"|ignoreblank=y| alt | attributes | beatified_by | beatified_date | beatified_place | birth_date | birth_name | birth_place | canonized_by | canonized_date | canonized_place | caption | child | death_date | death_place | death_cause | feast_day | home_town | honored_in | honorific prefix | honorific suffix | honorific_prefix | honorific_suffix | honorific-prefix | honorific-suffix | honoured_in | image | image_size | imagesize | influenced | influences | issues | major_shrine | major_works | name | patronage | residence | resting place | resting place coordinates | resting_place | resting_place_coordinates | suppressed_by | suppressed_date | titles | tradition | venerated_in | regexp1 = misc[%d]* | regexp2 = module[%d]*}}{{#invoke:Check for conflicting parameters|check
